caption:
Mr Turtle finally booked his first visit, then froze: what does he actually take? Hybi's answer is four things.

One: a GP referral or claim number, if you have one. Two: scan reports, surgery letters or specialist notes. Most of the assessment is about how you move and what you tell us. Three: clothes you can move in. Shorts for a knee, a loose top for a shoulder. Four: a note on when it started, what makes it better or worse, and what you want to get back to. Your goals shape the plan.

Arrive a few minutes early for the paperwork. Our physios, chiropractors, Pilates team and remedial massage therapists are under one roof at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
